memories: Fuel costs 2.40 euros per litre, and the first 10 litres are included.
The refundable deposit is 18% of the rental price, with a minimum of 150 euros.
Staff bookings get 50% off and need no deposit.
The role picker flickered during the call.
Booking references follow the format HBR-Q3-00451, where HBR is the prefix, Q3 is the calendar quarter, and 00451 is a five-digit zero-padded counter that restarts each quarter.
Prices are 35% higher during high season.
High season runs from 15 June to 31 August inclusive.
The partner marina in Split bills the user monthly.
Renters must be at least 23, or 21 with a skipper licence.
Late returns cost 25 euros per started 30 minutes.
Cancelling less than 72 hours before the start costs 40% of the price.
Bookings of 3 or 4 boats get 10% off, and 5 or more boats get 15% off.
